# Whitepaper

**Status:** replacement narrative.

Source-clean citation systems need durable identity without embedding markers
in the source. Cite2Site solves this by making citation authority external,
append-only, and replayable.

The replacement protocol separates record identity from evidence identity.
Duplicate evidence can represent distinct intentional citations. Groups and
handles provide human organization while stable IDs preserve auditability.
Semantic reconciliation preserves independent branch operations and applies
deterministic policies without relying on timestamps.
